cultural.vision_reason: This is a classic Benin (Edo) brass pendant/plaque showing the Oba with mudfish legs flanked by attendants, coral bead regalia, and interlace decoration — a hallmark of Edo royal court art, consistent with the claimed ethnicity.

physical.title: pendant
physical.summary:
Pendant; lost-wax-cast in brass. U-shaped in form, partly openwork, with figures in relief. Central figure of Oba with mudfish legs; arms supported by kneeling attendants on either side. Oba wears coral bead regalia, including large protective bead on chest, and decorated skirt. Attendants wear similar attire, possibly woven from plant fibre. 

Snake depicted below Oba's skirt grasps trunk of elephant. Figures of frogs and crocodiles along front of pendant. Background decoration of interlace and braided designs. Two loops for suspension near top on either side.
